title_me: GTA VI za jedan dan zaradio 3,79 milijardi dolara
title_en: GTA VI earned $3.79 billion in a single day
points_me: Rockstar Games kaže da je prodaja prvog dana dostigla 3,79 milijardi dolara, rekord za zabavnu industriju u bilo kom mediju.
Prije izlaska prodato je 32,5 miliona primjeraka.
Dostupna je na PlayStationu 5 i Xboxu Series X|S.
points_en: Rockstar Games says day-one retail sales reached $3.79 billion, a record for entertainment in any medium.
32.5 million copies were sold before launch.
The game holds a score of 99 on Metacritic.
Out now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
story_me: Rekord za zabavnu industriju u bilo kom mediju.
story_en: A record for entertainment in any medium.
caption_me: Grand Theft Auto VI je prvog dana prodaje zaradio 3,79 milijardi dolara, objavio je Rockstar Games. Prije izlaska prodato je 32,5 miliona primjeraka, a igra ima ocjenu 99 na Metacriticu.
caption_en: Grand Theft Auto VI made $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, Rockstar Games says. It sold 32.5 million copies before launch and holds a 99 on Metacritic.
